notes.label: Purpose
notes.text: Product catalog for UniPlus, built from Product_Details.xlsx and the labelled photoshoot images; column format follows PRODUCT-DATA-REQUIREMENTS.md §12. One row per colourway x size.

notes.label: Assumption 1
notes.text: Size run XS–XXL assumed from the requirements doc §10 — no size data exists in the source; client to confirm per product.

notes.label: Assumption 2
notes.text: Price, SKU, barcode, per-variant inventory, composition, care, fit, weight and HS code left blank — absent from source data; client to fill before publishing.

notes.label: Assumption 3
notes.text: source_quantity in the audit column is the source sheet's per-colour total quantity, NOT per-size inventory.

notes.label: Assumption 4
notes.text: country_of_origin set to India and vendor to UniPlus — confirm.

notes.label: Assumption 5
notes.text: "(common)" styles merged into single unisex products (4 merges).

notes.label: Assumption 6
notes.text: Combined colours split per requirements doc; reversible bodysuit colourways kept as single two-tone entries.

notes.label: Assumption 7
notes.text: YELLOW has no family in the doc vocabulary — Lemon/Butter Yellow mapped to ORANGE family; Wine→RED; Oat/Creme/Beige Gold→BEIGE; Ink Blue→DENIM.

notes.label: Assumption 8
notes.text: The 4 audit columns (match_confidence, source_quantity_colour, source_names, match_notes) are working columns — delete before seeding if the seeder rejects extras.

notes.label: Assumption 9
notes.text: Image cells hold Google Drive view links for the synced "Lorum Ipsum resources" folder.
